استؤممت (form X)
# اُسْتُؤْمِمْتُ (ustuʔmimtu) /us.tuʔ.mim.tu/: first-person singular past passive of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
# اُسْتُؤْمِمْتَ (ustuʔmimta) /us.tuʔ.mim.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
# اُسْتُؤْمِمْتِ (ustuʔmimti) /us.tuʔ.mim.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of اِسْتَأَمَّ (istaʔamma)
